hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[7rem] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter font-light
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-tight tracking-tight font-light
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-amber-500

rules: Headlines MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) and light weights for an editorial feel.
Overlines MUST be uppercase and widely spaced.
Use text-balance for headings to prevent orphans.
No pure black (#000000); use deep charcoal (#0A0A0A).
Accent color (#C8963E) should be used sparingly for high-impact moments (CTAs, hover lines, active states).
Avoid large flat gradient backgrounds. Rely on solid dark tones with subtle noise/grain.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Gap-12 or gap-16 between structural elements.
grids: Use highly asymmetrical grids for the portfolio. Mix tall, wide, and square ratios.
For Services, use a structured 2x3 or 3x2 grid with 1px subtle borders (border-collapse style) to look like a high-end catalog.
surfaces: Glassmorphism (Crystal): Only for the sticky navigation. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/10.
Cards: Flat solid #141414 with 1px border-white/5. Hover adds an amber border-bottom or subtle amber glow.

components.navigation: Fixed to top. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70. Must have active section tracking (amber dot or line under active link). Logo left, links center, CTA right.
components.hero: Cinematic full-screen height (100vh). Subtle parallax background image. Large kinetic headline with masked line-by-line reveal. Two CTAs (Primary solid amber, Secondary outline white).
components.about_manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) acting as scroll-triggers. Includes a floating accent card for philosophy, overlapping the main grid. Inline stats embedded in text.
components.services: 6 Interactive cards (Outdoor Kitchens, Pergolas, Hardscape, BBQs, Lighting, Fire/Water). Hover state reveals an image background or amber accent.
components.stats_divider: Animated counters triggered on viewport entry. Minimalist typography.
components.portfolio_grid: Oversized thumbnails. Hover reveals category and location (Boca, Delray, Wellington, Aventura) via an overlay or sliding text. Images clipped nicely.
components.process: 4-step horizontal or vertical timeline (Discovery → Design → Build → Reveal). Interactive line drawing path.
components.testimonials: Carousel with minimalist quote design. Includes Homeowner, Architect, Real Estate Agent.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for Service Areas. Font-serif, large outline or pale text.
components.contact: Form with Shadcn select/inputs. Dark inputs with amber focus rings.
components.footer: Large brand logo at bottom. Links organized clearly. Instagram social link.

rules: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Hero: Line-by-line masked text reveal on load using framer-motion (y: 100%, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, overflow: hidden).
Scroll reveals: Fade up and subtle translation (y: 40px) for all major sections.
Micro-interactions: Hover on portfolio images should subtly scale image (scale 1.05) inside an overflow-hidden container.
Parallax: Subtle y-axis translation on the hero image background.
Images should be treated deliberately. Add subtle overlays (bg-black/30) so text remains readable.
Images should feel like high-end editorial photography.

images.description: Cinematic modern house illuminated at night. Use as Parallax hero background.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST install required icon libraries (@phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react) and framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis.
Do not use generic centered layouts or flat gradients. Use high contrast, asymmetrical bento grids, and solid dark backgrounds with 1px subtle borders.
Text MUST be readable. Ensure contrast against dark backgrounds. Use #C8963E solely for accents and interactive states.
All interactive elements MUST have micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use deep charcoal like #0A0A0A or #121212.
Header MUST NOT have a pure transparent background. It must have a backdrop-blur and semi-transparent solid color so text is readable over the hero image.
Use standard semantic HTML tags (nav, section, main, footer) correctly.
Implement a smooth momentum scroll wrapper using Lenis.
